headline: YPF Agribusiness Division Reaches $344 Million in Third-Quarter Revenue
summary: Argentine state-backed energy firm YPF reported third-quarter agribusiness revenue of $344 million, bringing year-to-date sales for the segment to $826 million, up 23.1% year-over-year.
why: YPF is Argentina's largest oil and gas company, and its agricultural division supplies crucial inputs to the nation's key farming sector.

impacts.name: YPF
impacts.why: Revenue growth in its agribusiness division diversifies and boosts total corporate cash flow.
